* Temp workaround for moe-cache with scaled data-types

* Also apply scales in CPU backend 's tiled mul_mat

* Make *scale tensors use existing GGML_OP_MUL buffer probe

* Make scale tensors required for ggml_type with needs_scale=true

* Transform companion FP8 scales

* Add comment explaining intended use of activation scales

* Fix pre-existing view-handling failure in meta backend

eae135bd4 exposed an issue with single-ton dimension ambiguitiy + views
in meta backend, see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/actions/runs/39765669007/job/119780422102

* Enforce scale side-cars for scaled data-types during conversion

* tq quants also need scales

* llama: use map for scale tensors instead of manual handling

Assisted-by: Codex

* Fix conversion edge-case for FP8 block-scales

* Revert "tq quants also need scales"

This reverts commit 5920e55b0170bf376318935dd814a47823e5efb3.

* Disable dedicated kernels also for kleidiai in requant test

We want to test requant errors so we should be using the same kernels
to avoid a cofounder

* Add separate tests for scaled and unscaled DSV2

* Also remove IQ from needs_scale related tests/behvaior

* Wire activation scales and disallow broadcasting over K

* Adjust build_* in lfm3.cpp

* Avoid internal includes in test-llama-arch for moe scales

items.body:
<details open>

graph : read recurrent states in place instead of copying (#28841) (#30139)

* graph : read recurrent states in place instead of copying (#28841)

This is a graph only change that speeds up token output in the majority of cases and backends by removing state copy steps.
Where possible, kernels now read recurrent states directly from the cache instead of a copy from ggml_get_rows.
A change to RWKV6/7 makes it read its old state before overwriting.
A graph-reuse check condition is added to keep track of whether states are read in place.

Assisted-by: Claude Opus 5.5 + Sol 6.1

* graph : keep recurrent-state graph the same shape, both when read in place or for movement

Vulkan and Metal failed under GGML_SCHED_NO_REALLOC. The readers now always read the states from cache.
Graph shape is mainmtained throughout.

Assisted by: Opus 5.5

* Prevent any throughput regressions from caching clashing with speculative decoding rollback snapshots. Fix WebGPU CI error by skipping the fusion step when input states overlap with the cache it writes to.

* Refactor comment on rollback snapshots in llama-graph

Simplified comment.

* tests : add regression test for after memory clear

* graph : check rs_in_place when reusing the hybrid iswa rel input

* graph : document build_rs rules, read src0 directly in get_rs_in_place

* graph : expose the rs snapshot rule once via get_rs_snapshots

* graph : drop the repeated snapshot rule from the build_rs comment

* graph : clarify the build_rs snapshot comment

</details>
